macros.name: cvssFrame
macros.doc: This macro will output a CVSS tag based on a CVSS level passed as argument.

macros.name: cvssLevel
macros.doc: This macro will output the CVSS level from an {⟨input vector⟩} (without CVSS3.1/), for example Info.

macros.name: cvssLevelpretty
macros.doc: This macro will output the colored CVSS level from an {⟨input vector⟩} (without CVSS3.1/).

macros.name: cvssPrint
macros.doc: This macro will print all details of a CVSS string: colored level, score, and hyperlink to FIRST calculator, from an {⟨input vector⟩} (without CVSS3.1/).

macros.name: cvssScore
macros.doc: This is the main macro of this package, responsible for computing the base CVSS 3.1 score of an {⟨input vector⟩} (without CVSS3.1/).

macros.name: cvssTag
macros.doc: This macro will output a colored tag with the CVSS level inside, from an {⟨input vector⟩} (without CVSS3.1/).
